episodes.name: The Golden Child
episodes.overview: When the Sinclair baby sprouts a golden horn, he is trumpeted as the prophesied King of the Dinosaurs.

episodes.name: Family Challenge
episodes.overview: When the Sinclairs' TV is wrecked, Earl enters the family on a game show to win a new set.

episodes.name: I Never Ate for My Father
episodes.overview: When Robbie flubs his initiation into the Young Males' Carnivore Association, Earl fears his son may be a herbivore.

episodes.name: Charlene's Tale
episodes.overview: Charlene gets a tail, which whips up strange feelings in Earl, whose little girl is no longer so little.

episodes.name: Endangered Species
episodes.overview: Earl buys Fran two rare grapdelites for dinner, unaware that they are the last of their species.

episodes.name: Employee of the Month
episodes.overview: Earl anticipates a promotion as he awaits a dinner with Richfield; Robbie brings home a "pet" human.

episodes.name: When Food Goes Bad
episodes.overview: Lurking in the Sinclair refrigerator are delectable creatures that go bad, very bad, while Charlene watches the baby.

episodes.name: Career Opportunities
episodes.overview: Robbie objects to the career--tree pusher--assigned to him by the "Job Wizard."

episodes.name: Unmarried ... With Children
episodes.overview: A liberated single female's ideas make Fran reconsider renewing her marriage license.

episodes.name: How to Pick Up Girls
episodes.overview: Robbie gets pointers on how to approach girls from a streetwise contemporary named Spike.

episodes.name: Switched At Birth
episodes.overview: The Sinclairs learn that the baby might have been switched with another.

episodes.name: Refrigerator Day
episodes.overview: Earl's fridge is repossessed as the dinosaurs celebrate Refrigerator Day and the gift of cold storage.

episodes.name: What Sexual Harris Meant
episodes.overview: Earl helps Fran's friend Monica get a job as a tree pusher, but she's no pushover when she's harrassed by a predatory male.

episodes.name: Fran Live
episodes.overview: Fran gets a job on TV giving advice to dinosaurs, leaving Earl to learn how to cope with a wife who works.

episodes.name: Power Erupts
episodes.overview: A power struggle erupts between the Wesayso Corp. and Robbie after he invents a way to generate energy as a science project.

episodes.name: The Clip Show
episodes.overview: An archaeologist documents dinosaurs' way of life as they may have existed long ago, but clips from previous episodes tell a different story.

episodes.name: A New Leaf
episodes.overview: A wild plant has a weird effect on the dinosaurs--it makes them dopey and happy, to the exclusion of everything else.

episodes.name: The Last Temptation of Ethyl
episodes.overview: Earl thinks Old Ethyl has died, but she returns from the great beyond with the lowdown on the afterlife.

episodes.name: Nuts To War (1)
episodes.overview: The four-legged dinosaurs encroach on the pistachio-nut supply of the "normal" dinosaurs...and that means war.

episodes.name: Nuts To War (2)
episodes.overview: Earl, Roy and Charlene pose as entertainers and rush to the front to retrieve Robbie.

episodes.name: And The Winner Is...
episodes.overview: Earl throws his hat into the ring as a candidate for Chief Elder, but he's likely to have his head handed to him by his opponent, B.P. Richfield.

episodes.name: Slave to Fashion
episodes.overview: Charlene wants to make a fashion statement with an expensive coat, but the coat leads her into a vain attempt to achieve status.

episodes.name: Leader of the Pack
episodes.overview: When Robbie can't beat a gang of hoods (who keep beating him), he joins them.

episodes.name: WESAYSO Knows Best
episodes.overview: Wesayso insists Roy replace Earl as the father of the Sinclairs, who are selected as the Wesayso spokesfamily.
